name: Infrastructure as Code
description: Infrastructure as Code standard. Defines enforceable rules, implementation boundaries, failure handling and review evidence expected when STD-IAC applies.

rules.title: Manage infrastructure through version-controlled declarative code
rules.detail: Production infrastructure changes are represented in reviewed IaC except emergency changes that are subsequently reconciled.
rules.example_good: The implementation and review evidence demonstrate: Manage infrastructure through version-controlled declarative code.
rules.example_bad: The change violates or ignores the rule: Manage infrastructure through version-controlled declarative code.

rules.title: Use remote protected state and locking where required
rules.detail: IaC state containing infrastructure metadata/secrets is access-controlled, encrypted and protected from concurrent modification.
rules.example_good: The implementation and review evidence demonstrate: Use remote protected state and locking where required.
rules.example_bad: The change violates or ignores the rule: Use remote protected state and locking where required.

rules.title: Plan before apply and review material changes
rules.detail: CI or operators produce a change plan; destructive/security/network changes require explicit approval.
rules.example_good: The implementation and review evidence demonstrate: Plan before apply and review material changes.
rules.example_bad: The change violates or ignores the rule: Plan before apply and review material changes.

rules.title: Keep modules reusable but bounded
rules.detail: Modules expose intentional inputs/outputs, pin provider/module versions and avoid hidden cross-environment coupling.
rules.example_good: The implementation and review evidence demonstrate: Keep modules reusable but bounded.
rules.example_bad: The change violates or ignores the rule: Keep modules reusable but bounded.

rules.title: Do not embed secrets in IaC source or plan output
rules.detail: Reference approved secret stores and prevent sensitive values from being logged or committed.
rules.example_good: The implementation and review evidence demonstrate: Do not embed secrets in IaC source or plan output.
rules.example_bad: The change violates or ignores the rule: Do not embed secrets in IaC source or plan output.

rules.title: Detect configuration drift
rules.detail: Regularly compare actual infrastructure with desired state and reconcile authorized emergency changes.
rules.example_good: The implementation and review evidence demonstrate: Detect configuration drift.
rules.example_bad: The change violates or ignores the rule: Detect configuration drift.

integration_guide.title: Resolve applicability and dependencies
integration_guide.description: Confirm where STD-IAC applies and resolve its extends/implements/uses/aligns_with dependencies in the project standard profile.

integration_guide.title: Record project decisions
integration_guide.description: Apply the rules of Infrastructure as Code to requirements/design/ADRs and record any project-specific thresholds, providers or justified exceptions.

integration_guide.title: Implement with evidence
integration_guide.description: Implement the applicable MUST/SHOULD rules and link code, configuration, tests or review evidence to the change.

integration_guide.title: Verify before completion
integration_guide.description: Run automated checks where possible and manual review for judgement-based rules; close or approve documented deviations.

common_issues.issue: Infrastructure as Code is applied inconsistently across features
common_issues.cause: The project references the standard but does not resolve concrete ownership, thresholds or verification evidence.
common_issues.solution: Resolve dependencies, record project-specific decisions and include applicable rules in implementation/review checks.

common_issues.issue: Implementation satisfies the happy path but misses Infrastructure as Code failure cases
common_issues.cause: Boundary, retry, security or recovery scenarios were not included in acceptance/test planning.
common_issues.solution: Use the standard rules to add explicit failure/recovery scenarios and verify them before release.
